### AI Policy

|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — WO2 defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** Conceptual/philosophical bioethics articles (8,000-12,000 words), NOT empirical research studies. Recent June 2025 issue (Vol 35 No 2) carried: public health ethics and nonmaleficence under uncertainty; relational autonomy in nonideal medical decision-making; the ethics of pandemic lockdowns (plus a reply/response exchange); history of bioethics training/institutions (KIE's role in establishing German medical ethics); book reviews (space bioethics, diagnosis/medicalization). A PhilPapers-indexed special issue, "Situating Neurodiversity and Madness," edited by Quill R. Kukla & Rua Mae Williams, shows the journal has also run special issues on neurodiversity/mad studies in bioethics.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** conceptual/philosophical analysis, normative/ethical argumentation, policy analysis (health, environmental, science policy), history of bioethics/institutional history, book review essays, reply/response pieces to previously published articles

### AI-Research Notes (WO2 pipeline — sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://kiej.georgetown.edu/announcements/ai-policy-added-to-kiej-submission-guidelines/
- https://kiej.georgetown.edu/submit-to-the-kiej/
- https://muse.jhu.edu/issue/56673
- https://philpapers.org/rec/KUKITT
- https://scirev.org/journal/kennedy-institute-of-ethics-journal/ — page explicitly states "No reviews have yet been submitted for this journal"; all duration/rejection-rate/acceptance-rate fields show n/a

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint policy stated anywhere on kiej.georgetown.edu, kiej.scholasticahq.com/for-authors, or press.jhu.edu journal page; only a simultaneous-submission clause ("not under consideration at another journal") was found, which does not address preprint servers.
- **peer_review.type (double- vs single-blind)**: Submission guidelines only require author-side anonymization; no statement confirms whether reviewers' identities are also hidden from authors (true double-blind) or just author-blind (single-blind from reviewer's view).
- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev page for this journal has zero submitted reviews (n/a on all metrics); no discussion found on muchong.com, zhihu, fabiaoji, or Reddit r/AskAcademia via web search.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: Same as above — SciRev 0 reviews, no forum/cross-language discussion surfaced.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand author accounts found in any queried source (SciRev, muchong, zhihu, fabiaoji, Reddit).
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete first-hand source describing reviewer tone/culture; fabricating a narrative would violate the no-subjective-claim-without-source rule.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per WO2 rules):**
- 小木虫/知乎/fabiaoji (combined WebSearch query for "Kennedy Institute of Ethics Journal" 投稿) — 0 relevant results; only journal's own English pages returned
